name: Yotsuya Kouhei
source:
She is a new nursery school teacher who started working at “Uguisu nursery school” this spring.

He is a caring, energetic, and kind young man. He is mentally and physically exhausted from the harder work than he had imagined, but he manages to do his daily duties with his positive personality,

He is affectionately called “Kou-chan” by his colleagues and housewives. He has a somewhat childish face and small build, and the housewives are beginning to love him.

He is basically passive, but when push comes to shove, he has a manly side to him.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/momo_hina/mama/index.html]official site[/url]]
